stem.text: A ladder is positioned on icy (frictionless) ground and is leant against a rough wall. At the instant of release it begins to slide.
Which diagram shows the directions of the forces $P$, $W$ and $R$ acting on the ladder as it slides?

B.alt: Ladder leaning against a wall on the ground, with arrows labelled P, W and R
